subject: alt-f
title: ALT.F.------APP.RDEF.
description: Second diagram on page 459 (TRF(CW)-31). The crossing diagrams how alternative functionalism structurally meets applied-redefinitions: ALT-F crossed with APP-RDEF. ALT-F sits at lower-center with the subject-arrow; APP-RDEF at upper-center as partner-axis. STF (source transfer) upper-left, SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) upper-right. CRTF-DEF (cross-transfer definitions) left, EXT-FT (extended functionalism) right, PRI-INFO (principle information) center-left. (P)POST (point of idea completion, postulation) center-right. MT-INFO (multi-information) center. MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) lower-left, PROG-CONT (progressional continuance), POL-CONT (political continuance) lower-right, DOC (documentation) right.
